crossRefs.note: “ ‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean…
For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves…
“ ‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be…
“ ‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days.…

translations.web: or whoever touches any creeping thing whereby he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
translations.bsb: or whoever touches a crawling creature or a person that makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be—
translations.kjv: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness
translations.asv: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
